# Test fixture

`tts-fixture.mp3` is about 3.5 seconds of synthetic speech made with espeak-ng (text-to-speech), reading a sentence
written for this repository (the `TEXT` in `make_fixture.py`). It is not Legislature audio, not Invintus audio and not
a recording of a person. It is the only audio file allowed in the repository, and `.gitignore` names it.

`make_fixture.py` shows how it was made. The tests do not run it.
